liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Intro, At Dawn**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [5]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Heartbreakin' Man, The Bear, Old September Blues, Honest Man [5]

## The recordings

- **mmj1999-12-14.shnf** (recommended): FM broadcast; 5 songs; 27 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]

## Around the show

- WFPK hosted the live series at the Bunbury Theatre for this performance [4]
- John Gage, who produced the series, opened the show [4]
- Atlanta pianist Moon also performed during the event [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **mmj1999-12-14.shnf**: taped by Videotaped by Jason Neely for LocalShow.com Canon XL1S; transferred by Extracted and seeded by Jason Neely (bondibox); source: Pre FM source from WFPK -> CD -> EAC -> shntool tracks -> shorten v3.4 [1]

## Art and photos

- Poster by archive.mymorningjacket.net: [My Morning Jacket Live Archive - 1999-12-14 Bunbury Theatre - Louisville, KY](https://archive.mymorningjacket.net/index.php/shows/1999/1999-12-14-bunbury-theatre-louisville-ky) [6]
